description: NaLiICl crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to two equivalent I and four equivalent Cl atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaI₂Cl₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Na-I bond lengths are 3.11 Å. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Li is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent I atoms. All Li-I bond lengths are 2.89 Å. I is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing INa₂Li₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Cl is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent Na atoms.
